plugins.name: qa-agent
plugins.description: Agentic QA assistant: requirements analysis into risk-ordered test plans, browser execution through playwright-cli commands with a saved page snapshot per step, API testing, structured bug reports, and Jira via a bundled REST client. No MCP servers.

plugins.name: git-agent
plugins.description: Drafts a commit message - title and description - from the current working-tree changes, matched to the repository's existing commit style. Presents the draft for review and never commits without an explicit go-ahead. No MCP servers.

plugins.name: pw-setup-agent
plugins.description: Sets up and maintains a Playwright + TypeScript test project in tests/ using page objects, fixtures and typed test data, and checks that the project follows the conventions and works. No MCP servers.
